mapper.select: SELECT * FROM ( SELECT id, session_id AS sessionId, question_id AS questionId, role, content, model_name AS modelName, status, error_message AS errorMessage, latency_ms AS latencyMs, create_time AS createTime FROM ai_chat_message WHERE session_id = #{sessionId} AND user_id = #{userId} AND status = 'success' AND TRIM(content) != '' ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT #{limit} ) recent_messages ORDER BY id ASC
